title: 第3章 吃人的世道

第3章吃人的世道
晨辉破晓。
一轮红日自东而起，光巡四方，照亮天地，扫去连日大雨带来的阴霾。
“炼化会消耗我的体力，体力耗尽也不会停止，而是要达到某个目标。初步推测，是每次10进度。
但也说不定，孤证不举，有待尝试验证。”
“盲目的劈砍不会增长进度，是无用功。10进度或许相当于老爷子练刀三年？”
“现实里练刀也会增加进度，但效果远不如暴食之鼎的‘炼化’……且断刀本体并未消失。”
“暴食之鼎会褪色，或许进度满了就会变回原本的颜色，那么，怎么解决吃土的问题？”
“暴食之鼎需要的是什么？是泥土石头，还是其中蕴含的金属物质？如果是后者……”
“怎么寻找其他食材？”
略有些刺眼的阳光下，杨狱伏案书写，梳理着自己的所得与猜测，总结收获与得失。
这是他前世的习惯。
“呼！”
顺手填了一枚石子入腹，感受着熟悉的暖流散开，杨狱才长长的吐了一口气。
一夜的梳理，他已经初步了解了那口暴食之鼎的作用与禁忌。
问题很多，用处，也很大。
胡乱的将涂鸦的纸张揉碎，丢在角落，杨狱起身，将墙上悬着的断刀握在手中。
顿时，一种熟悉的触感涌上心头，一并涌来的，是深深烙印在脑海之中的用刀技巧。
是的，仅仅是技巧，甚至算不上刀法。
“失踪，等于死。老爷子只怕凶多吉少了……”

阳光落在刀面，映出杨狱略带忧愁的面容。
城外，很危险。
不止是时有出没的野兽与逃荒的流民乞儿，还因为山贼响马。
青州地处大明边陲，比起其他州，混乱不少。
一个年岁很大了的老狱卒，就算不死，还有的好吗？
砰砰砰！
这时，一阵急促的敲门声伴随着一道尖锐的声音打破院内的平静：
“二婶，开门啊，开门啊。是我，云花啊！”
“哎，来了。”
杨狱皱眉之时，杨婆婆已披着衣服上前
门一开，一个妇人已经进了门。
她约莫三十来岁，擦着劣质腮红，声音尖锐的打着招呼，她身后，是几个憨厚的中年汉子。
“这些人……”
杨狱皱眉。
这些人似乎都算是他家的亲戚，只是好些年似乎也没走动过了。
这时候上门……
“你们怎么都来了？”
一夜辗转反侧，杨婆婆脸色并不是很好看。
“婶子，二叔的事，族里也知道了。我们这次上门，为的就是要为他老人家操办后事。”
那妇人叹了口气：“二叔他活着没享过什么福，死了，怎么也得风光一回，你说呢？”

“后，后事。”
杨婆婆脸色一白，身子晃了一晃：“你二叔他只是失踪，会，会回来的，会回来的。”
说到最后，她的声音也低了下去。
“二婶啊！”
妇人上前拉过杨婆婆的手：“衙门的行事你还不清楚？那三尺刘哪里舍得给二叔抚恤？”
“是啊，二婶。这都好些日子了，可再拖不得了。”
那几个汉子也都附和着。
“这……”
杨婆婆手足无措，有着无助。
“二婶，你还犹豫什么？你点个头，之后的事，侄媳妇一定办的妥妥当当，不要你操一点心！”
眼见杨婆婆似乎被说动，妇人语气更多了几分温和，只是她嗓音尖利，听的人极为不舒服。
“这事不但要办！还要大办特办！”
这时，又有人附和着。
“那是，那是！”
中年妇人先是点头，后有警觉，扫了一眼，就见一脸色发白的少年依靠在门前，冷淡的盯着自己。
冷眼看着院内的几个‘亲戚’，杨狱只觉心头有着一团火在跳。
他两世为人，到底不止是个乡野少年，哪里不知道这几人的目的是什么？
吃绝户！
他曾听说过，但凡一家的男人若是死了，同家族的人就会上门，将家里值钱的都会被搜刮走，锅碗瓢盆也不拉下。
甚至会假借出丧的借口，日日上门，逼着这家人摆流水席，要一直摆，请大家都来吃，把这户人家吃绝，吃光！

直至把房产，土地全都交出去，逼得女人远走，甚至上吊自杀！
相传，一代名妓柳如是就是被吃绝户所逼，硬生生吊死家中，可哪怕这样，她死后也仍然被夺走了家财！
杨狱万万没有想到，自己有一天居然也会碰上这样的事情。
“这位就是小狱吧？”
妇人面色一僵，忙又挤出一抹笑容来：“一年没见，都已经是个大人了。”
“小狱。”
杨婆婆松了口气，忙挣脱妇人的手掌，后退几步。
“婆婆。”
杨狱扫了院内几人一眼，才看向老婆婆，温声道：“挑个合适的日子，把老爷子的后事，给办了吧。”
“可……”
杨婆婆欲言又止，但见杨狱目光坚定，却也只能点头应下。
“小狱说的可太对了！”
妇人本以为这事又有波折，此时见似乎成了，顿时喜上眉梢：
“哪还用挑什么日子？今个，可就是顶好的日子！”
“今天不行！”
杨狱摇头，见妇人面色不虞，才道：“至不济，也得等衙门的抚恤下来。”
顿了顿，又加了一句：
“这事，王捕头可是应承了我的。”
“王捕头？”
妇人一愣，眼珠子一转，有些迟疑：“可衙门办事想来拖沓，若是拖个一年半载可怎么好？”

‘真就这么迫不及待。’
杨狱眼神一冷，咬着牙才将火气压了下去：“三天后，抚恤就会下来，到时候哪怕没有，老爷子的后事，也是要办的。”
“那……”
妇人犹豫了一瞬，见几个汉子没啥意见，方才点头答应。
“唉。”
送走几人，杨婆婆就是长长一叹，越发的憔悴了：“小狱，这可如何是好……”
到底活了大半辈子，她如何能不知这些人的目的？
但知道又有什么法子？
家里的田亩、乃至于房屋，可都在族里登记在册，就是告官，也赢不了。
“婆婆，把田契、房契一并给我。”
重重的合上门，杨狱气性未消。
曾有一瞬，他恨不得抽刀杀了这几人。
可杀了这几人，还有其他人，而自己要是被抓，婆婆就真没有一点指望了。
“你想卖了这些田？行不通的，这些田契、房契都在族中挂着号，没有人会收的……”
老妇人连连摇头。
杨狱咬着牙，却是笑了：
“卖给他们，他们当然不要。可，要是送给他们呢？！”

Chapter 3 The world of cannibalism
The morning light breaks.
A red sun rises from the east, and its light travels in all directions, illuminating the sky and earth, sweeping away the haze caused by the heavy rain for days.
"Refining will consume my physical strength. It will not stop when my physical strength is exhausted, but to achieve a certain goal. Preliminary guess is that it will progress by 10 each time.
But it’s possible that there is no single evidence, and it remains to be tried and verified. "
"Blindly chopping will not increase the progress, it is useless. 10 progress may be equivalent to the old man practicing swordsmanship for three years?"
"In reality, practicing the sword will also increase the progress, but the effect is far less than the 'refining' of the Cauldron of Gluttony... and the broken sword itself has not disappeared."
"The Cauldron of Gluttony will fade, and maybe it will return to its original color when the progress is full. So, how to solve the problem of eating dirt?"
"What does the Cauldron of Gluttony need? Is it earth and stone, or is it the metal contained in it? If it's the latter..."
"How to find other ingredients?"
Under the slightly dazzling sunlight, Yang Yu wrote at his desk, sorting out his gains and guesses, and summarizing his gains and losses.
This was his habit in his previous life.
"Phew!"
After filling a stone into his belly, Yang Prison let out a long breath as he felt the familiar warmth spread out.
After a night of sorting out, he had a preliminary understanding of the functions and taboos of the Cauldron of Gluttony.
There are many problems and great benefits.
Randomly crumbling the graffiti paper and throwing it into the corner, Yang Yu stood up and held the broken knife hanging on the wall in his hand.
Suddenly, a familiar feeling came to my mind, along with the skill of using a knife that was deeply imprinted in my mind.
Yes, just skills, not even knife skills.
"Missing is equal to death. The old man is only afraid of the worst..."
The sun fell on the blade, reflecting Yang Yu's slightly sad face.
It's very dangerous outside the city.
Not only are there wild animals and refugees and beggars who are fleeing from famine, but there are also bandits and horse thieves.
Qingzhou is located on the border of the Ming Dynasty and is a lot more chaotic than other states.
A very old jailer, even if he doesn't die, is he still good?
Bang bang bang!
At this time, a rapid knock on the door followed by a sharp voice broke the calm in the courtyard:
"Second Aunt, open the door, open the door. It's me, Yunhua!"
"Hey, here we come."
When Yang Yu frowned, Granny Yang had already put on her clothes and stepped forward.
When the door opened, a woman had already entered.
She was about thirty years old, wearing low-quality blush, and said hello in a sharp voice. Behind her were a few honest middle-aged men.
"These people..."
Yang Prison frowned.
These people seemed to be his relatives, but they didn't seem to have moved around for several years.
Come to the door at this time...
"Why are you all here?"
After tossing and turning all night, Granny Yang's face didn't look very good.
"Auntie, the clan also knows about my second uncle. The reason why we came here this time is to arrange the funeral arrangements for his old man."
The woman sighed: "Second uncle, he has never enjoyed much happiness in life. After death, he will not be able to enjoy the glory again. What do you think?"
"Later, funeral affairs."
Grandma Yang's face turned pale and her body swayed: "Your second uncle just disappeared. He will, will come back, will come back."
At the end of the sentence, her voice dropped.
"Second aunt!"
The woman stepped forward and took Granny Yang's hand: "You still don't know what the yamen does? How can Liu, who is three feet tall, be willing to give pension to his second uncle?"
"Yes, Second Aunt. It's been a long time, but we can't delay it any longer."
The men also agreed.
"This..."
Grandma Yang was at a loss and felt helpless.
"Second Aunt, what are you still hesitating about? Just nod your head, and my nephew-in-law will take care of everything from now on, so you don't need to worry about it!"
Seeing that Granny Yang seemed to be persuaded, the woman's tone became more gentle, but her voice was sharp and made the listener extremely uncomfortable.
"Not only does this matter need to be done! It also needs to be done in a big way!"
At this time, someone else echoedWith.
"That's it, that's it!"
The middle-aged woman nodded first, then became alert. She glanced around and saw a pale-faced boy leaning in front of the door, staring at her coldly.
Looking coldly at the "relatives" in the courtyard, Yang Yu felt a fire beating in his heart.
In his two lives, he was more than just a country boy. How could he not know what the purpose of these people was?
Eat extremely well!
He had heard that if a man in a family died, members of the same family would come to the house and plunder all valuables from the house, including the pots and pans.
They would even come to the house every day under the pretext of going to mourn, forcing the family to set up running water mats, and they would keep setting them up, inviting everyone to come and eat, and eat them all up!
Until all the properties and land are handed over, the woman is forced to run away, or even hang herself!
According to legend, a generation of famous prostitute Liu Rushi was forced to live in poverty and was hanged at home. But even so, her family fortune was still taken away after her death!
Yang Yu never thought that he would encounter such a thing one day.
"Is this Xiao Jiao?"
The woman's face froze, and she forced out a smile: "I haven't seen you for a year, and you are already an adult."
"Little prison."
Grandma Yang breathed a sigh of relief, hurriedly broke away from the woman's hand, and took a few steps back.
"Mother-in-law."
Yang Yu glanced at the people in the courtyard, then looked at the old woman and said warmly: "Choose a suitable day to take care of the old man's funeral affairs."
"But..."
Granny Yang hesitated to speak, but when she saw Yang Yu's eyes were firm, she could only nod in agreement.
"What Xiao Jiao said is so right!"
The woman originally thought that there would be another twists and turns in this matter, but when she saw that it seemed to be the case, she suddenly became happy and said:
"Why do you need to pick a day? Today is the best day!"
"Not today!"
Yang Yu shook his head, and when he saw the woman's worried expression, he said, "Even if it doesn't work out, we have to wait for the Yamen to provide compensation."
After a pause, he added:
"Wang Captou agreed to this matter."
"Wang Captou?"
The woman was stunned, rolled her eyes, and hesitated: "But the yamen is procrastinating on doing things. What if it takes a year and a half?"
‘I really can’t wait. ’
Yang Yu's eyes turned cold, and he gritted his teeth before suppressing his anger: "In three days, the pension will be paid out. Even if it is not available by then, the old man's funeral arrangements will still have to be taken care of."
"Then..."
The woman hesitated for a moment, and seeing that the men had no objections, she nodded in agreement.
"Alas."
After sending a few people away, Granny Yang let out a long sigh and became more and more haggard: "Xiao Jing, what should I do..."
After all, after living for most of her life, how could she not know the purpose of these people?
But what can I do if I know?
The family's land and even the house are all registered in the clan, so even if they sue the officials, they won't win.
"Mother-in-law, give me the land deed and the house deed together."
The door was closed tightly, but Yang Yu's aura was still there.
For a moment, he wanted to kill these people with a knife.
But after killing these people, there were others, and if she was caught, her mother-in-law would really have no hope at all.
"You want to sell these fields? It won't work. These field deeds and house deeds are all registered with the clan, and no one will take them away..."
The old woman shook her head repeatedly.
Yang Yu gritted his teeth and smiled:
"Sell it to them, of course they don't want it. But what if you give it to them?!"
